1.consolidated_definition: dep. Por invitación. En los campeonatos deportivos se dice de los restringidos a participantes que han sido invitados. Anglicismo adaptado, frecuente. Jonathan Andino y David Fernández se proclamaron campeones del segundo evento invitacional de boxeo aficionado entre Puerto Rico y México celebrado el pasado fin de semana (El Expresso de )
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Invitational (by invitation). In sports championships, it refers to participants who have been invited, as opposed to those who are restricted to competitors from the general pool. Anglicism adapted, frequent.

Note: El Expresso de is a newspaper title that has been translated as "The Express" for context purposes only
